# Changelog

This page records notable changes to the Boundary Administration Guide.

## 2026-11

- Added field guidance on Vault credential store tokens and least-privilege policies, credential library parameter templating, KMS-led worker authorization with Vault Transit, file event sinks and log levels, and ITSM-integrated Terraform management.

## 2026-08

- Restructured legacy Boundary HVD content into the HVD 2.0 Boundary Administration Guide as part of the Installation / Administration / User guide migration.
